title: Escala tokens.json
description: Canonical payload from generateTokenJSON(). Not W3C DTCG. additionalProperties stay allowed so additive fields (schema v6+) validate. Required core matches plugin import. See CONTRACTS.md.

schemaVersion.description: TOKEN_SCHEMA_VERSION in src/lib/tokenGenerator.ts. Live version is 7. Theme foundation collections are additive under foundationsByTheme.

project.description: Display name the plugin uses for the Figma file. The sync URL slug is slugify of this name.

background.description: Page background the ramps and alpha twins are solved against.

primitive.description: Flat prefixed ramps: accent-1…12, neutral-*, error-*, and -dark twins when a dark theme exists. Custom families use the same shape.

primitiveAlpha.description: Overlay twins (accent-a-1…). Background-dependent. Replaces the retired opacity scale (v5).

semantic.description: Light-theme flat roles. Plugin compatibility slice. Prefer colors.themes / colors.architecture for new consumers.

themes.description: Theme name → role id → hex. Role keys are the current catalogue only (no stale architecture keys).

themeModes.description: Canonical theme model: theme name → light/dark appearance → semantic role id → hex.

themeOrder.description: Figma Color Semantics mode / column order.

activeTheme.description: Library theme the configurator is previewing, or `theme::appearance` when Sync flattened Light/Dark into Color Semantics columns. Overview / Cover read this column's brand family as the identity ramp. Additive — older plugins ignore it.

themeSources.description: Shipped theme → slot (brand/gray/error/…) → primitive family key. Plugin groups Color Primitives from this. Additive.

themeLabels.description: Shipped theme key → display name (My themes label).

semanticArchitecture.description: flat is the editing matrix. categorical is the only projection that ships. Astryx, shadcn, Vibrancy, Tonal and Carbon were removed.

architecture.description: Projected view. Always includes kind. Categorical tokens nest group → key → theme → hex.

foundationsByTheme.description: Additive resolved foundation collections keyed by library theme. Existing root foundation fields remain the compatibility fallback.

roles.description: v6 additive. Semantic type roles alias primitives; they do not store a second px. `tablet` is additive (optional): only display and headings step there.

viewports.description: Which viewports Dimension Semantics gets as Figma modes (Desktop · Tablet · Mobile), canonical order, at least one. Chosen in File & modes; additive.

dimensions.description: Dimension primitives: ONE global collection of lengths, named by value ('16', '-4', '9999', '3_5' = 3.5px), single mode. Standard ladder plus every length a shipped theme uses. Key order is not numeric; sort by value.

dimensionRefs.description: Category (spacing, padding, radius, sizes, selector, stroke, grid) -> step -> '{dimension.N}'. Which primitive each length aliases; the category maps keep the resolved px. Also per theme under foundationsByTheme.<theme>.dimensionRefs.

spacingRoles.description: Desktop static step each spacing role resolves to (gap-tight → "1"), or a pinned Dimension primitive ("dimension-20"). The responsive link lives in spacingRoleRefs.

spacingRoleRefs.description: Role → the token it aliases. A responsive ref (gap-section → section-md) steps down per viewport; a static step or dimension-* holds one value.

spacingResponsive.description: 18 tokens (component|section|layout × xl…none). Each value is the static spacing step at desktop, tablet and mobile.

padding.description: Per-side inset. Resolved px of spacing-inset-surface on a fresh system.

radiusRoles.description: Role → a radius step (container → 2xl) or a pinned Dimension primitive ("dimension-21"). A step follows radiusResponsive on Tablet and Mobile unless radiusRoleViewports overrides it.

radiusRoleViewports.description: Hand-set radius roles on tablet and mobile. A role absent here follows radiusResponsive.

radiusResponsive.description: Radius step → the static step it reads at desktop, tablet and mobile (2xl → 2xl / xl / xl).

shadowsDark.description: Dark-appearance twin of shadows. Same keys. Light `shadows` is unchanged.

gridStyles.description: Named layouts (XL Desktop, SM Mobile, …) resolved to px. Only styles whose viewport ships.

gridFrame.description: v6 additive. Desktop/tablet/mobile aliases into spacing + breakpoint primitives.

breakpointRoles.description: v6 additive. desktop | tablet | mobile → a breakpoint step, or a pinned Dimension primitive ("dimension-1000").

sizeRoles.description: control | compact | touch | hit | fab → a size step, or a pinned Dimension primitive.

selectorRoles.description: control | compact | indicator → a selector step, or a pinned Dimension primitive.

strokeRoles.description: v6 additive. divider | control | focus → a stroke step, or a pinned Dimension primitive.

borders.description: Plugin v5 compat. borders.width is a copy of stroke.

weight.description: Phosphor weight this system renders: thin, light, regular, bold, fill or duotone.

sizes.description: Icon scale (xs 12 … 2xl 32) and roles (control-md → a scale step). Roles are derived from control heights.

descriptions.description: Additive. Figma collection name → variable name → description. Plugin sets Variable.description on sync.

section.description: Workspace section id (see src/lib/workspaceLink.ts). App URL is /?project=<slug>&section=<id>. Not an /api/tokens query param.

editor.description: Additive publish handshake. Present only when the configurator published a workspace section. Older plugins ignore it. /api/tokens GET still keys only on project.
